* CalCOFI DB - Ichthyoplankton tows conducted using standardized CalCOFI methods (not just CalCOFI cruises proper, e.g. trawl cruises), 1951 to present. Primarily bongo tows but also manta, Calvet/pairovet, and a smattering of others.
* SQL Server DB on estrella-g
* CUFES - Continuous Underway Fish-Egg Sampler data, 1996-present. SQL Server DB on estrella-g
